by_reason.label: Partial overlap between two releases
by_reason.why: The two folders share some track titles but not all. That is the exact shape of an alternate edition, of a compilation absorbing an EP, and of a remaster with bonus tracks -- three different answers behind one identical set of numbers. Nothing in the files separates them.
by_reason.needs: the label and year of each release, the running time of the shared tracks, and what MusicBrainz says about the relationship between the two -- evidence that lives outside the audio files.

duplicates.note: EXACT_DUPE and INCOMPLETE_COPY are quarantine-eligible (quarantine_eligible=true; for INCOMPLETE_COPY the winner is the COMPLETE copy). BONUS_EDITION/VARIANT_EDITION/SAME_NAME_DIFFERENT_CONTENT/NEAR_EDITION/DIFFERENT_DISCS/SAME_TRACKS_DIFF_DURATION/PHANTOM_SAME_PATH/AMBIGUOUS_* are kept (DIFFERENT_EDITION remains only when track titles are unavailable). Groups of 3+ are ALL protected and listed in larger_groups, but only those whose members are sibling discs are labelled MULTI_DISC_SET — REPEATED_COPIES means three or more copies of the SAME album, not a box set. Their folders stay protected in every other pair (PROTECTED_GROUP_MEMBER). Resolved pairs and nested quarantine artifacts are excluded.
